Our Sales team is high-energy, customer-focused, and relentlessly innovative - committed to delivering cutting-edge UCaaS, CCaaS, and AI-powered solutions.</p> <p>As a <strong>ServiceNow</strong> <strong>Alliance Executive</strong>, you’ll be at the forefront of our ServiceNow ecosystem strategy—expanding our footprint and influence by building and managing powerful relationships.</p> <h2><strong>Why this role matters:</strong></h2> <p>The <strong>ServiceNow Alliances team</strong> is a key growth engine for Vonage—driving pipeline and revenue by aligning our business with ServiceNow and its extended ecosystem. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on relationship-building, strategic partnerships, and go-to-market execution.</p> <p>We’re looking for someone experienced in the <strong>ServiceNow ecosystem</strong> or with a strong background in <strong>partner management or alliances</strong>. If this sounds like you—keep reading!</p> <h2><strong>Your key responsibilities:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Drive Servicenow <strong>referral business</strong></li> <li>Build, nurture, and manage relationships with <strong>Servicenow teams and ecosystem partners</strong></li> <li>Align Vonage’s sales reps with their Servicenow counterparts to generate <strong>pipeline and close opportunities</strong></li> <li>Own <strong>executive alignment and sales engagement</strong>—position Vonage asServicenow’s top communication partner</li> <li>Plan and lead <strong>joint field outcomes</strong></li> <li>Coordinate and run <strong>interlocks, milestone tracking, and strategy sessions</strong> with partners and internal stakeholders</li> <li>Drive execution of regional <strong>go-to-market strategies</strong> with Servicenow and other alliance partners</li> <li>Deliver internal training sessions to equip Sales, Product, Services, and Support teams on partner partner program impact</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A relationship-driven professional who thrives in a partner-centric ecosystem</li> <li>Experienced in working with
